moat_against: No returns on capital yet: roic_proxy in fundamentals.json is negative every year 2021-2025 (-17.9%, -22.6%, -54.9%, -42.0%, -14.9%) and operating income is negative in every filed year
Gross margin compressed from 84.9% (2021) to 66.2% (2023) before recovering to 69.1% (2025) / 70.0% TTM — pricing power is contested, not proven
Real platform competition: Bruker (CosMx, ex-NanoString), Vizgen (MERSCOPE), Akoya in spatial; Parse Biosciences (Qiagen) and Illumina pressing in single cell
SBC consumes the cash: $98.7M TTM against $127.1M TTM operating cash flow; diluted share count +3.1%/yr (117.2M in 2023 to 129.1M TTM) despite no buyback

Revenue growth has stalled to low single digits ex-settlement (Q2 2026 +3% ex-settlement; FY2026 guidance $620M midpoint is below FY2025's settlement-inflated $642.8M) and funding is academic/government-budget exposed
moat_for: Largest installed base in single cell and spatial: Chromium (single cell), Visium and Xenium (spatial) form one integrated instrument + consumables + software ecosystem
Razor/blade consumables pull-through: Q2 2026 consumables $130.8M of $151.0M revenue, with Spatial consumables +16.2% YoY
Patent estate that wins in court: Delaware jury (2026) found three Scale Biosciences single-cell patents valid and willfully infringed by Qiagen's Parse unit, 14% royalty
High gross margin structure even after compression: 69.1% FY2025, 70.0% TTM, ~74% in Q2 2026 per the Q2 release
Workflow/data switching costs: lab protocols, analysis pipelines and published datasets are standardized on 10x file formats and software
moat_justification: Integrated Chromium/Visium/Xenium installed base with recurring consumables, workflow switching costs and a court-validated patent estate give a real but narrow platform moat. It is capped at 5 because the economics do not yet prove it: roic_proxy in fundamentals.json is negative in every year 2021-2025 (operating losses every filed year), gross margin fell from 84.9% (2021) to 66.2% (2023) before recovering to 69.1% (2025), and Bruker/Vizgen/Akoya/Illumina/Parse contest both platforms. A 5 gives CAP = 8.5 years.
name: 10x Genomics, Inc.
one_liner: Leading single-cell/spatial platform, moat 5/10, but owner's earnings have only just turned positive on a TTM basis ($0.18/share after $98.7M of SBC) — Tier D: weighted IRR sits at the ~3% model floor, weighted IV@15% is $1.68 vs the $71.95 price, and it clears 15% only below ~$1.68 (on the normalized 3-yr median base of -$1.22/share it is Tier F).
